expected_dmg.formula: 130 + 30*[PPP_this_turn]; value += attach min(3, basicF_in_discard) F-energy to a BENCHED pokemon (active never gets fueled by Aura Jab)

early.until: active is Mega Lucario ex (678) AND its energy >= 2
early.on_plan: first_attack_turn(Mega Brave) <= own 2nd-3rd turn; Riolu placed T1, evolved next turn, 2 F attached

mid.on_plan: post_ko_attack_rate high; a KO each own turn; self-lock turns filled by Aura Jab(+bench feed) or body relay; a bench Riolu/2nd Lucario kept

late.until: opponent prize_remaining <= 2 OR our 2nd Lucario at KO risk
late.on_plan: close 6 prizes; protect last Lucario with Cape/RockFighting/Wally/Switch; STOP non-essential digging when deck thin

doctrines.name: A_single_attacker_alternator
doctrines.plan: One Mega Lucario alternates Mega Brave(270)->Aura Jab(130)->Mega Brave; only one 3-prize body exposed; ~200 avg dmg/turn
doctrines.discriminating_metric: energy_attach_share concentrated on 1 pokemon; bench_size_dist shows ~0 second evolved Lucario; avg damage/turn ~200

doctrines.name: B_twin_tower_relay
doctrines.plan: Two Mega Lucario loaded; alternate which body uses Mega Brave (relay around the self-lock / around Wally-strip / around KO) to output 270-300 EVERY turn; Aura Jab pre-loads the bench body
doctrines.discriminating_metric: bench_size_dist includes a 2nd evolved+loaded Lucario; energy_attach_share split across two 678; but loss_share[prize] rises if opponent 2-KOs. A/B: force >=1 loaded bench Lucario vs single-body, compare winrate and loss_share[prize]

tensions.balance: keep a loaded bench Lucario ONLY when active.hp <= opp_max_damage (active at KO risk next turn); otherwise single-body (A) to expose one 3-prize target
fire Wally only if (active_target next-turn-KO-certain AND another body energy>=2) OR target is benched and not current attacker
stop Ultra Ball / Carmine once board assembled (678 loaded + a bench body); after that only non-discard search (PokePad/Gong/Dusk)
once active.energy>=2, route surplus manual attach and Aura Jab discard-energy to a bench Lucario

hypotheses.claim: Generic 'heal-when-damaged' logic fires Wally's Compassion on the active loaded Mega Lucario, stripping its energy to hand (verified ne 2->0) and leaving it unable to attack for ~2 turns
hypotheses.direction: trigger_fire[wally] must be ~0 when the healed target is the ONLY body with energy>=2 (i.e. Wally must not de-load the sole attacker)
hypotheses.risk_of_overtightening: gating too hard stops legitimate life-saving heals when the Lucario really would die and a backup exists, wasting the 4x Wally as pure dead cards
hypotheses.scenario: Active Mega Lucario ex at 310/340 with 2 basic F attached; bench has only an un-evolved Riolu with 0 energy; Wally in hand. L0 heals 30 -> active now 340/340 but 0 energy -> next turn cannot Mega Brave (needs 2), must spend turns re-attaching manually (Aura Jab does NOT fuel the active). Net: a full Mega Brave turn traded for healing 30 while opponent races prizes.

hypotheses.claim: Generic draw-supporter logic fires Carmine (discard entire hand, draw 5) while holding Mega Lucario ex or the only accessible Riolu, discarding the combo; 678 is unrecoverable from discard
hypotheses.direction: play_rate[1192] must be ~0 on turns where 678 is in hand and no 678 is already in play
hypotheses.risk_of_overtightening: blocking Carmine entirely kills its role as the best first-turn dig; keep it firing when hand has no irreplaceable piece
hypotheses.scenario: Turn 1-3, hand = {Mega Lucario ex, F Energy, Carmine, 2x filler}, Riolu active on board but not yet evolvable this turn. L0 fires Carmine to dig -> discards the Mega Lucario ex (only copy in hand) -> line broken, must draw into another of the 4 copies. If 678 prize-stuck, game is lost.

hypotheses.claim: Ultra Ball fired unconditionally discards 2 cards; with only 8 Pokemon total it can discard a needed Pokemon / the last F energy / Rock Fighting, a net loss
hypotheses.direction: play_rate[1121] must drop when the only discardable cards are needed pieces (678, last Riolu, last F)
hypotheses.risk_of_overtightening: over-gating Ultra Ball removes the deck's only tutor for 678 (Poke Pad/Gong cannot fetch it), slowing the combo

hypotheses.claim: After Mega Brave KOs and self-locks, if the active is then KO'd, L0 promotes by displayed damage to a bare/unloaded Lucario or Riolu that cannot attack (no 'loaded' check by energy>=2)
hypotheses.direction: post_ko_attack_rate must stay high; promoted/switched-in body should have energy>=1 (Aura Jab) or >=2 (Mega Brave)
hypotheses.risk_of_overtightening: forcing only loaded promotions can strand you with no legal promotion; must fall back to any Pokemon when no loaded body exists

hypotheses.claim: L0 pours all energy onto the active Mega Brave attacker (displayed 270) and never pre-loads a bench body, so after the active is KO'd or Wally-stripped there is no ready attacker
hypotheses.direction: once active.energy>=2, share of subsequent energy (manual + Aura Jab) to a bench Lucario/Riolu must be > 0
hypotheses.risk_of_overtightening: feeding the bench too early delays reaching 2 energy on the active and pushes back first Mega Brave; only feed bench after active is Mega-Brave-ready

hypotheses.claim: Aura Jab's value is undervalued: L0 sees 130<270 and never chooses it proactively, never stocks basic F in discard to enable its bench-acceleration, and may attach 0 (min=0) when it does fire
hypotheses.direction: when Aura Jab is used with basic F in discard and a bench Pokemon present, attached-count should be > 0 (up to min(3, F_in_discard))
hypotheses.risk_of_overtightening: always maximizing Aura Jab attach can dump F onto a bench body you will never promote, wasting energy that the active needs via manual attach

hypotheses.claim: Gravity Mountain is mis-timed: either not played vs Stage-2 opponents (its only value) or set down pointlessly (no Stage 2 in play, overwriting a useful stadium); it never hurts our own Stage-1 Mega Lucario (verified)
hypotheses.direction: play_rate[1252] should correlate with opponent having a Stage 2 in play (or removing an opposing stadium)
hypotheses.risk_of_overtightening: never playing it forfeits stadium control and the -30 vs Stage-2 metas (e.g. Alakazam)

hypotheses.claim: Boss's Orders gust targeting uses displayed active damage (270 >= 60, always fires) but picks a poor target instead of a KO-able bench threat / prize-dense body given our real 270-300
hypotheses.direction: gusted target should be one our current attack (270 or 300 with PPP) actually KOs, prioritizing prize value / denying setup
hypotheses.risk_of_overtightening: too strict a target filter wastes the gust when only a chip target exists but pulling it still advances the prize race

hypotheses.claim: Xerosic's Machinations (opp discard to 3) is fired reflexively, burning our once-per-turn supporter slot when we needed to draw/gust/heal
hypotheses.direction: play_rate[1197] should be low on turns we need our supporter for setup; fire mainly when opp hand is large and we have no better supporter use
hypotheses.risk_of_overtightening: never using it forfeits real disruption vs combo/hand-reliant opponents

hypotheses.claim: No 'stop digging when deck thin' rule: L0 keeps firing Ultra Ball / Carmine / Lillie every turn, and combined with self-lock stalls the game can deck the 60-card list out
hypotheses.direction: loss_share[deckout] must stay low; item/draw usage should throttle when deckCount low
hypotheses.risk_of_overtightening: throttling draw too early starves the hand and slows the combo; only throttle NON-essential search once board is assembled

hypotheses.claim: Hero's Cape (1 copy) or manual attach may go to a Riolu or an un-needed body instead of the Mega Lucario ex that should be the 440-HP wall
hypotheses.direction: Hero's Cape, when played, should be attached to a 678 (never a Riolu)
hypotheses.risk_of_overtightening: in rare board states (no 678 yet) attaching to a Riolu you will evolve is fine; do not hard-block

1102.trigger: Pokemon shortage; no-discard search of bottom 7

1121.name: Ultra Ball
1121.trigger: only if 2 discardable cards are surplus (not 678/last Riolu/last F); stop after board assembled

1123.name: Switch
1123.trigger: bring a loaded body active / retreat a de-energized or endangered Lucario without paying retreat 2

1141.name: Premium Power Pro
1141.trigger: just before attack when +30 converts a non-KO into a KO (opp active HP in (270,300] for Mega Brave)

1142.name: Fighting Gong
1142.trigger: active.energy<2 and no F in hand, or Riolu shortage; safe no-discard

1159.name: Hero's Cape
1159.trigger: attach to a Mega Lucario ex only (340->440)

1182.name: Boss's Orders
1182.trigger: our attack KOs a bench threat / prize-dense target this turn

1192.name: Carmine
1192.trigger: dig when hand stuck AND 678 not in hand (avoid discarding combo); best on first turn

1197.name: Xerosic's Machinations
1197.trigger: opp hand large AND we don't need our supporter for draw/gust/heal

1227.name: Lillie's Determination
1227.trigger: hand thin (<=4) AND not needing Wally/Boss this turn; safe (shuffles, no discard)

1229.name: Wally's Compassion
1229.trigger: GATED: target next-turn-KO-certain AND another body energy>=2, OR target benched; NEVER on the sole loaded attacker

1252.name: Gravity Mountain
1252.trigger: opponent has a Stage 2 in play, or to remove an opposing stadium; harmless to our Stage-1 wall
